title: Wiz Cloud Threat Landscape
short_description: Import Wiz Threat Detection Issues as OpenCTI Incidents with their affected cloud assets.
description: The Wiz Cloud connector polls the Wiz tenant GraphQL API (issuesV2) and ingests Threat Detection Issues as Incidents, creating the affected cloud resource as a System linked with a targets relationship. Not to be confused with the wiz connector, which imports the public Wiz Research feed from threats.wiz.io.
